newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - March 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - March 24.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on March 24:
WASHINGTON - The Federal Reserve Board's Alan Greenspan moves easily in his own world; perhaps he's not the drab, dreary guy people might think he is.

JERUSALEM - Friday's suicide bombing in Tel Aviv followed months of private warnings to Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat by Israeli and U.S. officials, including a message by Clinton delivered during his meeting with Arafat last month.
WASHINGTON - The American Cancer Society recommended that women in their forties undergo annual breast X-rays or mammograms.
WASHINGTON - Ethnic donors are playing an increasinly powerful role in American politics, as evidenced by the huge amount of money contributed to one South Dakota senate race last year.
WASHINGTON - Those 1950s-style home shopping parties are making a comeback with a 1990s twist.
